messages:
amanda: Quick sync: RFC follow-up — we want to deprecate the X-Client-Version header semantics on api/v1 in favor of Accept-Version. Need a practical migration plan (shims vs client push). Thoughts?
kevin_w: +1 to a short-lived ingress shim. Give customers time; add telemetry and a hard cutoff. Avoid forcing mass client changes. :+1:
raj.patel: shim makes sense. Mapping rule suggestion: if X-Client-Version present -> set Accept-Version: v1 and add X-Compat-Mode: legacy. For unknown values, map to v1-old. Example mapping:
```
X-Client-Version: 1.2.3 -> Accept-Version: v1
X-Client-Version: beta-foo -> Accept-Version: v1-old
```
must include audit log for each rewrite.
maria-g: Ops note: ingress-level rewrites increase CPU and slightly impact p95 for small requests. Can we make it tenant-opt-in (flag) so only affected customers pay the cost? Also prefer not to touch streaming endpoints.
joel: We need telemetry keys planned: compat.migration=header-shim, shim.reason=deprecation, shim.owner=eng-platform. Add tags for tenant_id and client_id so we can track adoption.
sre-bot: [automated] Canary deployment started for ingress-shim on staging cluster: canary-04.
deploy-bot: Canary deployed to staging at 10:42. Observability link: https://grafana/redwood/d/shim-canary
sre-bot: [automated] Alert triggered: increased 503s on /v1/stream endpoints during canary.
kevin_w: Hm — likely header rewrite interfering with streaming chunk handling. Quick mitigation: skip header rewrite on endpoints that have Transfer-Encoding: chunked or content-type that signals streaming. Also exclude /v1/stream explicitly.
amanda: Proposed plan (short):
1) Implement ingress shim that is tenant-opt-in (tenant flag) and defaults off.
2) Shim rewrites for non-streaming endpoints only.
3) Add telemetry metric compat.header_shim.requests and compat.header_shim.rewrites and dashboard.
4) Canary excluding streaming traffic, monitor 2 weeks, then enable wider canary.
5) After 6 weeks of stable telemetry, announce deprecation and schedule header removal 8 weeks later.
Owners: maria-g -> canary+perf, raj.patel -> mapping + tests, joel -> telemetry dashboards.
maria-g: I can own canary and perf validation. Will schedule load test to measure CPU delta and p95 impact.
raj.patel: I'll implement mapping + unit tests + compatibility-toggle. Will add a small example script for partners.
joel: I'll add dashboards and an alert for compat.header_shim.rewrite_rate > 0.5% of traffic (so we catch unintended rewrites).
amanda: Thanks — I'll update the RFC with the plan and post a PR for the ingress config. @kevin_w can you create the perf task and link it to the RFC?
kevin_w: Filed perf task ENG-1234 and linked it in the RFC.
amanda: Cool. Please ping this thread with canary results. We'll aim to start tenant opt-ins next week. :rocket:
